chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Fadala, from Aban, from Abu al-Jawrad, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him)

regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Indeed, you are of an exalted moral character.' He said: It is Islam. It was also reported that the exalted moral character is the Exalted Religion.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic phrase 'exalted moral character' refer to according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s interpretation linking the 'exalted moral character' of Prophet Muhammad to the essence of Islam or the Great Religion, emphasizing that true nobility stems from adherence to divine guidance. This exegesis highlights the Shia view that the Prophet’s character is not merely personal virtue but the embodiment of the faith itself, serving as a model for believers to attain spiritual elevation through religious practice.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from his father, from Fadala, from Aban, from Abu’l-Jaroud, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Indeed, you are of an exalted moral character.» [68:4] He said: It is Islam. It was also reported that exalted moral character is the Exalted Religion.
